content:
alex.chung: Heads-up — multiple customers hitting intermittent 502s from the hosted API when doing long streaming requests (chunked). Noise started ~04:10 UTC. Attaching quick repro and logs below.

jin.park: Thanks — any correlation IDs or sample request bodies? Is this only streaming or normal gen too?

alex.chung: All early reports are streaming. Example curl I used to repro:

alex.chung: ```bash
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --http2 
  -d '{"model":"gpt-open","stream":true,"input":"hello\n"}'
```

carmen.vazquez: I grabbed edge logs for one failure: 

carmen.vazquez: ```
[2026-03-17T04:11:08Z] EDGE request_id=rq_7f3b auth_tier=hosted route=/v1/generate upstream=nginx-03 status=502 msg="upstream prematurely closed" conn=fd123
[2026-03-17T04:11:08Z] UPSTREAM trace=tx_9a2c body=stream chunks=12 last_chunk_len=0 
[2026-03-17T04:11:08Z] FRONTDOOR request_id=rq_7f3b metadata_size=9216 -> trimmed to 8192 field=tenant-meta
```

carmen.vazquez: Notice: metadata_size=9216 -> trimmed to 8192. Looks like a recent frontdoor change clamps header fields.

jin.park: That header trim would cause Envoy/NGINX to see malformed/truncated metadata header and then close upstream. Which proxy rolled this out?

infra-bot: deploy-bot: rollout frontdoor/edge-l7: v2.8.4 -> v2.9.0 completed 04:05 UTC :package: (changed default max_field_size=8192)

alex.chung: Bingo. Repro steps: large tenant metadata (~9k) + streaming -> 502. Non-streaming with same headers seems to succeed more often but still flaky.

maya: Repro tip — use --http2 and send large header:

maya: ```bash
curl -v --http2 -H "Tenant-Meta: $(python -c 'print("x"*9000)')" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"stream":true}'
```

oncall: Paging infra oncall. If this is global, we should hotfix and rollback frontdoor change. Can someone triage impact by region?

carmen.vazquez: Quick numbers from observability: ~130 502s in last 10m, 95% from us-east and eu-west, 70% streaming calls, user-agents include sdk-js v1.4 and curl.

jin.park: Short-term mitigations: 1) rollback edge-l7 change, 2) add temporary header-safety middleware to drop oversized tenant-meta before reaching nginx, or 3) make nginx tolerant to truncated fields (not recommended). Which is fastest?

alex.chung: Rollback is fastest. I can open rollback PR. Also recommend a customer-facing note for affected tenants with large metadata.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: rollback frontdoor/edge-l7 -> v2.8.4 initiated by @alex.chung at 04:18 UTC

maya: For engineering follow-up: add a metric for "header-trim-event" and an alert when >50/min. Also validate SDKs that send metadata to avoid unchecked growth.

jin.park: I'll add an integration test that simulates oversized tenant headers on streaming paths. Also adding a gate in deployment to warn when default max_field_size changed.

carmen.vazquez: Sending a concise support note to impacted customers: short description, workaround (reduce tenant metadata or use SDK update), ETA for rollback and follow-up.

alex.chung: Customer note draft (short): "We're investigating intermittent 502s on streaming requests — root cause: a recent edge proxy change that clamped large metadata headers. We're rolling back the change and recommend reducing tenant metadata size as a temporary workaround. We'll follow up when fixed."

oncall: Rollback completed at 04:20 UTC per deploy logs. Observability: 502 rate dropping to baseline.

carmen.vazquez: Confirmed — post-rollback 502s from the sample trace set dropped to 3 in last 5m (was ~120).

alex.chung: Actions: 
- alex.chung: follow up with rollback PR notes and postmortem doc (owner)
- jin.park: add tests + deploy gate (next patch)
- maya: metric/alert for header-trim events
- carmen.vazquez: send support message + customer list

jin.park: Will also check if any SDKs are appending unbounded tenant metadata. Might add client-side truncation by default.

maya: +1 on client-side truncation. We should define a safe header size (e.g., 6k) for SDKs and console UI.

alex.chung: Thanks all. Marking this as resolved for the incident channel; postmortem will live in /incidents once drafted. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: incident-bot: incident created INC-2026-0317-01 for edge header clamp causing 502s (owner: alex.chung)

carmen.vazquez: Follow-up note: add a regression test that catches frontdoor changes to default config values (max_field_size, max_header_size) before rollout.

alex.chung: Agreed. Closing thread once postmortem posted.
